facts.text: The environment module imports gymnasium as gym
Environment is a gym.Env subclass and its docstring says it follows the OpenAI Gym interface
Environment(configs) takes a config file path or raw config dictionaries, merged sequentially

The default env config uses gm.DEFAULT_SIM_STEP_FREQ for action_frequency, gm.DEFAULT_PHYSICS_FREQ for physics_frequency, gm.DEFAULT_RENDERING_FREQ for rendering_frequency, automatic_reset False, flatten_action_space False, flatten_obs_space False and num_envs 1
gm.DEFAULT_SIM_STEP_FREQ is 30
A simulator step interval is sim_step_dt = 1.0 / action_frequency, so the 30 Hz default is 1/30 s
The action space is a Dict of each robot's name to robot.action_space; flatten_action_space replaces it with one Box
The observation space is assembled from every robot's, the task's and the external sensors' spaces and stored as a Dict; flatten_obs_space keeps a flattened Dict
step takes an action and n_render_iterations and calls og.sim.step() once
step returns the five-tuple (obs_list, rewards, terminateds, truncateds, infos)
A termination condition named timeout sets truncated; every other done condition sets terminated
automatic_reset resets only the environments whose done flag is set
reset takes env_indices, get_obs and **kwargs (it declares no seed parameter) and resets the task and the step and episode counters
reset returns (obs_list, {'obs_info': info_list})
close is a no-op to satisfy RL frameworks
render returns None when the environment has no external sensors
The default config has no robots and its task type is DummyTask
DummyTask creates no termination conditions and no reward functions
BaseTask._step_reward starts from zeros and adds every reward function's output
The docs call Environment an OpenAI gym-compatible interface and the main entry point for interacting with the simulation
The docs step the environment with obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step(action)
The docs list step, reset, render, observation_space and action_space as the Gym-like interface
The documented construction is env = og.Environment(cfg)
Installation requires an NVIDIA RTX 2070+ GPU with 8GB+ of VRAM

determinism.notes: no determinism claim: the upstream Environment.reset declares no seed parameter (env_base.py:838) and passes the bridge's seed keyword into **kwargs without reading it, so cap.world.seed.v1 cannot make a run reproducible; the fake restarts from a fixed pose, which was not compared with any upstream run

gaps: the fake is a reduced kinematic stand-in for OmniGibson, not the simulator: one robot with two position-controlled joints and proprioception only, no scene, objects, contacts, dynamics, actuators, sensors or noise; the joint positions jump to the commanded values

the action and observation spaces are reduced: upstream action_space is a Dict of robot name to robot action space (env_base.py:429) and observation_space a Dict of robot, task and sensor spaces (env_base.py:386-423); the fake's two-joint spaces and their bounds are placeholders, not the real robot's control limits

the fake returns one environment's observation and scalar reward and flags; upstream step returns per-environment lists and tensors (env_base.py:730-735, 807) and reset returns an obs list (env_base.py:903)
no seed or determinism: upstream reset has no seed parameter (env_base.py:838), and physics and asset randomisation are not modelled

the default DummyTask has no termination condition and no reward function (dummy_task.py:15-21), so the fake never terminates and pays 0.0; a BEHAVIOR-1K activity task would terminate on its own conditions
timestep_ms is the upstream default action interval (30 Hz, macros.py:219 and env_base.py:83); the fake advances no simulated time and is not wall-clock paced
no rendering (render returns None without external sensors, env_base.py:809-813), no snapshot or restore (the environment exposes no get_state/set_state), and no physical device is modelled
the upstream Environment was never imported or run here (Isaac Sim 5.1.0, RTX GPU, setup.sh:339) and the fake was never compared with it

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the last observation and counters stay readable
